title: Writing / Duo
slide_intent: Give a mascot a defined relationship with people so its persistence feels like a recognizable personality.
strategic_value: Describing Duo as an enthusiastic supporter can align reminders and encouragement around one character.
demonstration: The blue introduction pairs a paragraph describing Duo’s supportive, persistent personality with the owl and a speech bubble.
practical_value: Define who the mascot is to the audience before writing in its perspective.
